alt: A straight stone-edged ship canal cut through a flat desert at golden sunset, a steam-and-sail merchant ship gliding down the channel, a stone signal station and a small camel caravan on the near bank

A steam-and-sail merchant ship with a tall dark funnel, a trailing wisp of smoke and furled sails glides down the middle of the channel, with a second smaller ship far behind it. On the near bank, a simple stone signal station with a tall mast, a small lock-keeper's house, wooden mooring posts, and a caravan of a few tiny camels with drivers walking along the sandy track. A few date palms and tamarisk bushes dot the bank, and low desert hills and a faint town on the far horizon. A clear apricot-and-teal sky. The buildings and ships are plain, with no lettering, flags, banners or markings anywhere. The straight canal with the ship gliding down it is the clear focal point, with calm sky above and open sand below.
